signals.title: Bochabela, Bloemfontein (approx.): the Lekone twins, owners of Ekhayeni Lounge, shot dead in their vehicle; no arrest, 21 Oct
signals.content: The Lekone twins, both 52 and owners of Ekhayeni Lounge, were shot dead in their vehicle at a business premises in Bochabela, Bloemfontein, on the morning of Wednesday 21 October, according to police. Police received the complaint at about 08:51 (Free State police spokesperson Lt Col Thabo Covane, via NovaNews). A witness reportedly saw a man flee in a white hatchback. Two murder cases were opened at Mangaung Police Station. As of 24 October police had announced no motive and no arrests, and had dismissed rumours of arrests (Radio Bloem). The sources disagree on the street: NovaNews gives the corner of Mkhuhlane Road and Morakile Street and the police quote names Morakile Street; Radio Bloem gives Ramatsoele Street. The map point is a Bochabela suburb point, not the premises. Two public reports, resting on police: NovaNews, 21 October, and Radio Bloem, 24 October.

checked.incident: Wed 21 Oct 2026, morning; police received the complaint at about 08:51 (police, via NovaNews)

signals.title: Phase 7, Bloemfontein (approx.): man, 31, kidnapped and stabbed to death; five arrested, 4 Oct
signals.content: A 31-year-old man was found stabbed to death in a street in Phase 7, a settlement in the Bloemspruit area of Bloemfontein, at about 06:00 on Sunday 4 October, after he was allegedly forced into a vehicle following an argument, according to police. Police say he had been drinking with friends when an argument broke out with a group of strangers, who allegedly forced him into a black vehicle and drove away with him; paramedics declared him dead at the scene. A task team led by Bloemspruit detectives arrested five men aged 21 to 34, who were due in court on preliminary charges of kidnapping and murder. An arrest is not a conviction. The victim and the accused are not named. Sources: SAPS Free State statement, 4 October, and NovaNews, 5 October (Lt Col Thabo Covane). The map point is an area-level point in Phase 7 (Mangaung ward 51), not the street where he was found.

signals.title: Wilgehof, Bloemfontein (approx.): man, 57, allegedly fired at an 18-year-old and missed, then died; attempted murder case, inquest, 21 Oct
signals.content: Police say a 57-year-old man allegedly fired several shots in the direction of an 18-year-old in Wilgehof, Bloemfontein, on the afternoon of Wednesday 21 October, but missed. Police say he then took his own life; paramedics declared him dead at the scene. No other injuries were reported. Police received a distress call at about 14:26, and an attempted murder case and an inquest docket are being opened. No one is named. One public report, resting on police: Radio Bloem, 21 October. The map point is a Wilgehof suburb point, not the property.
